mentions.name: Gemwright
mentions.description: An open-source web port of UOFiddler for browsing Ultima Online game content — gumps, tile and item data, and animations — from the browser, since running the desktop UOFiddler on macOS is a struggle.
mentions.problem: Running UOFiddler on macOS is also another struggle when you need to work with UO game content (gumps, tile or item data, animations, etc).
mentions.source_excerpt: While doing this, I realized I need to find some game content (gumps, tile or item data, animations, etc). Similar to UO client, running UOFiddler on macOS is also another struggle. So I decided to port it to web.

evidence.value: While doing this, I realized I need to find some game content (gumps, tile or item data, animations, etc). Similar to UO client, running UOFiddler on macOS is also another struggle. So I decided to port it to web.
